errors.text: The required finite-size boundary of a 12x12x12 supercell containing 3456 atoms is omitted and replaced with an irrelevant criterion about destruction of SRO on dislocation slip planes under high stress.

The hypothesis conflates the MTP phase-space fidelity requirement with reproducing the electronic DOS gap and solid-state SRO. In the target mechanism, electronic Gibbs-energy and solid SRO corrections are separate physical contributions, while the MTP primarily enables low-variance liquid-phase sampling for FEP.
It requires high-temperature magnetic configurations in MTP training without support from the target, where magnetic fluctuations are neglected after tests indicate negligible impact.
